name: libxsmm-k-loop-two-step-unroll
hypothesis: The swarm-selected two-step unroll tests whether changing loop-control and load scheduling improves throughput. Each iteration loads two K steps, then performs eight FP32 FMOPA operations on the existing four ZA.S tiles, preserving each accumulator's K order. Separate one-step cleanup handles an odd remaining count; the generated path still uses K=512, and general sizes use the unchanged fallback. Only the two K-loop blocks change. ABI, streaming transitions, packing, stores and the complete BSD notice remain unchanged. This implementation is absent from the supplied measured history. Assembly, correctness and performance are untested; no gain is established. Validate under the fixed gates and use repeated paired unchanged controls on battery power with settings unchanged.
